Det 250 · Evaluator tool

    Step 1 · Who are you?

    Pick your position. This loads the cadets in your flight, your squadron's two flights, or all four flights for the Group Commander.

    Confirm your roster

    These are the cadets you'll rate and rank. Click a cadet to take them off your list if they don't belong, and add anyone who is missing.

    + A cadet is missing from this list

    Step 2 · Set your scoring weights

    How much should each area count toward a cadet's standing? In Step 3 you'll rate each cadet 1–5 in these areas, and the weights turn those ratings into a projected ranking. You always get the final say on the order in Step 4.

    Step 3 · Rate each cadet

    Go through your cadets one at a time. Rate each area 1–5 compared with their peers and jot down initial comments. Click any photo below to jump to that cadet.

    Step 4 · Review the ranking & submit

    You rank two separate lists: AS200 / AS250 / AS500 and AS100. Each starts in the projected order from your ratings and weights, split into top, middle and bottom thirds. Drag a cadet by ⋮⋮, use ▲▼, or click the rank number to move them within their list. Open a cadet (▾) to finish their comments — if you move someone away from their projected spot, say why.
